description: A different seed produces different data, so the generator is actually seeded rather than constant.
cmd: if diff -q <(node scripts/datagen.mjs --spec assets/templates/spec.example.json --seed 1 --rows 25) <(node scripts/datagen.mjs --spec assets/templates/spec.example.json --seed 2 --rows 25) >/dev/null; then echo 'seeds produced identical output'; exit 1; fi
provenance: guards the inverse of datagen-is-deterministic: a generator that ignores the seed would pass that case
